answer: Per-epoch generation cost gates entry: each independent agent must publish a fresh attestation whose proof-of-work target scales with its claimed standing, so a sybil fleet must re-mine every epoch rather than pay once. The cost per identity rises along a spiral as the network's total registered stake grows, meaning an attacker buying N identities pays roughly N squared in compute and deposit.
